name: Boarded (C)
body:
Your last home was a dangerous land of pirates and treachery, but also of fantastic opportunity. A life of weal and woe on the sea and amid the pirate controlled lands has toughened you to a variety of hardships.

Pick one of the three categories of saving throws—you gain a +1 trait bonus on all saving throws of that type.
